description: A four channel stereo mixer with level and a clickless mute on each channel, feeding a stereo pair of chain outputs

params.text: Sets the level of that channel, from silence to the full input
Silences that channel over 3ms, and unmutes it over the same 3ms, so it does not click

inputs.text: The left audio input of that channel
The right audio input of that channel; it follows the left input of the same channel when unpatched, which centres a mono source
A stereo mix arriving from another Chain-family module, added to the left output at the level it arrives
A stereo mix arriving from another Chain-family module, added to the right output at the level it arrives

outputs.text: The left output: the four channels at their levels plus the left chain input
The right output: the four channels at their levels plus the right chain input

notes: there is no pan control. A channel keeps the balance of its two inputs, and a mono source patched to the left input alone comes out centred
the chain jacks carry a running stereo mix. Patch one module's outputs into the next module's chain inputs to add channels, and take the last module's outputs as the mix
